title: Masks that end in a real character
summary: Password: ********x and Password: •••••••x: mask characters followed by one ordinary character, under the same key.
rationale: A masking rule based on a prefix of mask characters would treat a partially masked value as fully masked. A trailing real character means part of the secret is exposed, and the partial value is itself sensitive.

expectation.rationale: Flagged. The value is not entirely mask characters, so at least one secret byte is visible and the value is reported.
